title: Gang Suppression Force Begins Taking Over PNH Positions in Kenscoff
detail: Haitian authorities reported on September 1, 2026 that the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF) had begun assuming certain security positions in Kenscoff previously held by the Haitian National Police (PNH), part of the joint plan agreed after the August 23 massacre in which the GSF committed to strengthening its presence in the Port-au-Prince area while national security forces reinforced their deployment specifically in Kenscoff. The move follows the August 28 UN Security Council emergency session at which BINUH chief Carlos Ruiz Massieu welcomed increased coordination among the PNH, the Armed Forces of Haiti, and the GSF and urged the force's rapid, complete deployment; the GSF remained far short of its 5,500-person authorized ceiling, with roughly 1,000 personnel in-country, and its initial 12-month authorization is set to expire September 30, 2026 absent a Security Council renewal.

media.caption: HaitiLibre's September 1, 2026 news roundup reports the Gang Suppression Force taking over PNH positions to strengthen community protection in Kenscoff
